text:
anya: OrchidCloud QA found our runtime failing on a subset of their marketplace VMs during pre-GA smoke. Can we do a quick joint alignment?
kevin: what error?
anya: runtime aborts at startup: 'undefined symbol: cublasLtMatmul' on Nvidia boxes, and hiprtc link failures on AMD. CI run: https://ci.redwood.com/runs/12054
lucas: sounds like host CUDA/toolkit mismatch — their images still ship CUDA 12.1 while our wheel expects 12.2.
mei: also seeing kernel module symbol differences on some hosts, likely because they rebuild amdgpu against newer headers.
orchid-pm: Orchid ops asked for a 72h embargo on the GA announcement until we clear compatibility. Is that feasible?
kevin: yes if we can deliver a hotfix lane quickly. Proposal: produce two partner artifacts — 'orchid-patch-ami' (pinned driver + tested kernel) and 'orchid-float-bundle' (floating repo + manifest). Provide SI signed debs for air-gapped installs.
lucas: +1. For the runtime, we can publish a cuda-12.1-compatible wheel as a stopgap. Longer term we recommend partner images move to 12.2.
mei: add runtime guard: on nvml/rocminfo init failure, log a clear remediation link and fallback to cpu-quant path after 2 retries. That prevents immediate outages.
orchid-pm: Orchid ops will hold GA if you give a green by T+48h. They want a comms blurb for customers.
kevin: timeline suggestion: build signed driver debs + checksums by 09:00 PT tomorrow, hotfix AMI by 13:00 PT, publish manifest + SI README by 17:00 PT. Orchid to hold GA for 72h embargo window.
anya: smoke commands for the AMI (drop here):
```
sudo modprobe nvidia || dmesg | tail -n 50
python -c "import ctypes; ctypes.CDLL('libcublas.so').cublasLtMatmul"
./redwood-smoke --backend cuda --model embed-128 --tokens 256 --concurrency 2
/opt/rocm/bin/rocminfo || echo 'ROCm init failed'
```
lucas: I'll build the cuda-12.1-compatible wheel and smoke it on their image.
kevin: I'll produce signed debs + GPG manifest and upload to orchid-partner/bundles/hotfix/ (requesting write perms).
marketplace-team: granted temporary write to orchid-partner/bundles/hotfix/ until 4620000000.
mei: I'll add the runtime guard and telemetry tags: driver_bundle=orchid-hotfix and driver_mismatch=true.
deploy-bot: ci: created branch hotfix/orchid-driver-align-460123 and triggered jobs.
anya: comms blurb draft for Orchid release notes: 'Redwood validated runtime compatibility with OrchidCloud pre-GA images. For best results use the certified Orchard bundle or follow Redwood compatibility guidance. Reach support for migration help.'
orchid-pm: that works. We'll hold the GA and coordinate press timing with your stability signoff.
kevin: upload script for signed debs (example):
```#!/bin/bash
set -e
dpkg-deb --build redwood-driver-535.86.05
gpg --output redwood-driver-535.sig --detach-sign redwood-driver-535.86.05.deb
sha256sum *.deb > checksums.txt
gsutil cp *.deb checksums.txt redwood-driver-535.sig gs://orchid-partner/bundles/hotfix/
```
anya: regression plan: if hotfix AMI still shows failures, we escalate to vendor with kernel bisect artifacts and provide an emergency fallback: runtime auto-route to hosted endpoints in us-west-2 for affected tenants.
lucas: I'll attach smoke logs to ticket ORCH-201.
mei: action items summary:
- lucas: build cuda-12.1 wheel + smoke on Orchid image (due 4601240000)
- kevin: signed debs + checksums + upload (due 4601239000)
- mei: runtime guard + telemetry tag (due 4601243600)
- anya: coordinate Orchid comms & embargo (due today EOD)
orchid-pm: we'll pause GA and wait for your go/no-go. Thanks.
anya: please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept your item.
lucas: :white_check_mark:
kevin: :white_check_mark:
mei: :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: ticket created ORCH-201-driver-compat; linked CI runs: ci/12054, ci/hotfix-460123.
